+"""Record preparation steps reusing click value conversion helpers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import typing as t
+
+from click.utils import make_str
+
+
+def prepare(record: t.Any) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return a new prepared dict.
+
+    The result has exactly ``key`` (trimmed), ``value`` (unchanged),
+    ``display`` (``value`` converted with :func:`click.utils.make_str`)
+    and ``enabled`` (defaults to ``True``). The input is never mutated.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value entry")
+
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key.strip(),
+        "value": value,
+        "display": make_str(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

--- a/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_values/steps.py
@@ -35,3 +35,19 @@ def prepare(record: t.Any) -> dict[str, t.Any]:
         "display": make_str(value),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records: t.Any) -> list[dict[str, t.Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order, rejecting duplicate trimmed keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    prepared = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError("duplicate record key: " + repr(item["key"]))
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

         seen.add(item["key"])

+
+
+def group(records: t.Any) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Group display values of enabled records by first key character."""
+    grouped: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            grouped.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return grouped
